children: Curaleaf reiterates its offer representing a 45% premium to Aurora and argues the deal offers immediate value and stronger long-term prospects for Aurora shareholders.
Curaleaf says its offer provides a 45% premium to Aurora's unaffected price and implied CY2026E EBITDA multiple of 12.0x.
Curaleaf highlights Aurora's shareholder dilution: ~US$398M raised since Sept 2020 and ongoing ATM programs causing erosion.
Curaleaf contrasts cash flows: Aurora had negative operating cash flow in June quarter; Curaleaf generated US$157M LTM and US$50M H1 2026 operating cash flow.
Curaleaf notes its US$500M senior secured notes and lower net-debt-to-capital (~25%) vs peers, supporting liquidity and de-leveraging outlook.
Curaleaf emphasizes broader diversification, international footprint, aligned insider ownership (~20% economic interest) and expected regulatory catalysts.

title: Curaleaf Responds to Aurora Circular, Reiterates 45% Premium Offer and Strategic Rationale
